title: "Not Everything That Looks Christian Is Biblical" 🔥
paragraphs:
"Not Everything That Looks Christian Is Biblical" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 In a world full of spiritual messages, not everything labeled 'Christian' is biblically true.

It’s easy to be deceived.
✅ That viral faith meme you just shared…
✅ That motivational quote with a Bible verse…
✅ That trending Christian trend on social media…
They may sound good, but are they aligned with Scripture?
📖 “See to it that no one takes you captive through hollow and deceptive philosophy, which depends on human tradition rather than Christ.” (Colossians 2:8)
Let’s break down why this matters.

🔥 The Danger of Feel-Good Memes & Half-Truths
Social media is flooded with "Christian" quotes and inspirational posts that can mislead people.

Here’s the problem:
❌ Half-Truths: Sharing God's love but ignoring sin and the need for repentance.
❌ Twisted Scriptures: Taking verses out of context to fit motivational ideas.
📖 “For the time will come when people will not put up with sound doctrine. Instead, they will gather around them teachers to say what their itching ears want to hear.” (2 Timothy 4:3)
💡 Truth is not measured by popularity—it’s measured by the Word of God.

⚠️ 3 Myths That Sound Christian but Aren't Biblically True:
1️⃣ "God Helps Those Who Help Themselves" (FALSE)
✅ Myth: You have to fix yourself before God helps you.
✅ Truth: God helps the helpless who call upon Him.
📖 “But God demonstrates His own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.” (Romans 5:8)
God meets us in our brokenness. We don’t clean ourselves up—we come to Him as we are.

2️⃣ "All Paths Lead to God – Just Believe in Something" (FALSE)
✅ Myth: Every religion eventually leads to the same God.
✅ Truth: Jesus is the ONLY way to the Father.
📖 “Jesus said, ‘I am the Way, the Truth, and the Life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.’” (John 14:6)
💡 Not all beliefs are equal. Only faith in Christ alone saves.

✅ Myth: Viral posts with promises of instant blessings for likes and shares.
✅ Truth: God’s blessings are not triggered by social media activity but by His grace.
📖 “Seek first His kingdom and His righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.” (Matthew 6:33)
💡 Faith isn't a formula. God works according to His will, not based on a viral post.

🔥 What Makes Something Truly Biblical?
Here’s how to discern if a message aligns with God’s Word:
✅ 1. Is it rooted in Scripture?

Check if the verse used is quoted in context.
Example: Jeremiah 29:11 was written to Israel in exile, not as a personal financial promise.
✅ 2. Does it point back to Jesus?

True messages glorify Christ, not self-help or emotional validation.
📖 “For I resolved to know nothing while I was with you except Jesus Christ and Him crucified.” (1 Corinthians 2:2)
✅ 3. Does it align with the Gospel message?

The true Gospel message is:
Jesus died for our sins. (1 Corinthians 15:3)
He rose again. (1 Corinthians 15:4)
Salvation is by grace through faith alone. (Ephesians 2:8-9)
🌟 Why This Matters for Your Faith
Sharing incomplete truths can:
❌ Lead people to trust in works-based faith.
❌ Confuse those seeking truth.
❌ Water down the power of the Gospel.

✅ As believers, we must be truth bearers, not just trend followers.
📖 “Test all things; hold fast to what is good.” (1 Thessalonians 5:21)

🌍 What Should You Share Instead?
✅ Scripture in Context
✅ The Full Gospel Message
✅ Encouragement That Points to Jesus
💡 Before you hit "Share," ask:

Does this honor Christ?
Is this biblically sound?
Am I pointing people to Jesus or emotional hype?

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 12, 2025 📜
"I choose to share only biblical truth. I will test every message I hear and point people back to Jesus Christ alone. He is the Way, the Truth, and the Life!"

🔥 THE “SHARE TRUTH, NOT TRENDS” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Commit to fact-checking posts against Scripture.
✅ Step 2: Share a verse in context instead of emotional memes.
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends and encourage them to be truth-bearers.

🌌 DON’T COMPROMISE – STAND FOR TRUTH 🌌
The world needs truth, not feel-good messages.
People need Jesus, not vague positivity.
📖 “Sanctify them by the truth; Your Word is truth.” (John 17:17)
👉 Are you ready to be a voice for biblical truth?

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 12, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Thank You for giving us Your Word as the ultimate source of truth. Help me to discern what is truly biblical and reject messages that twist or water down Your Gospel. Give me boldness to share the truth, not for popularity but for Your glory. Let my words and actions point people to Jesus Christ alone.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️
